ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The Ding figure is located at the bottom of the figure and is labeled "Ding-Sichuan paddy field"; the small landscape image shows contiguous and regular paddy field/rice field scenery. Then reason: Sichuan paddy fields mainly involve rice planting. Rice planting usually requires relatively large labor input and meticulous field management, and has relatively high output per unit area.
